summary: 36-year-old Boulder man (Matthew Chan) crashed his mountain bike on the Hobbit 3 Trail (West Magnolia trails), suffering heavy bleeding from a femoral artery; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Nederland Fire, AMR, and Boulder County Sheriff responded; airlifted by Flight for Life to St. Anthony Hospital.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Nederland Fire Protection District; AMR; Boulder County Sheriff
notes: Source: The Mountain-Ear (Barbara Lawlor, Nederland). Incident date = the Fourth of July, 2014-07-04 (Friday-verified). Dedupe-checked: zero DB rows on 2014-07-04.
